name: Bari
source: Comune di Bari SIT / Area Vasta Metropoli Terra di Bari, with Regione Puglia ArcGIS REST cadastral parcel layer

queries.query: Bari Italy official cadastral parcel map GIS catasto parcels Comune di Bari
queries.result: Found the official Comune di Bari SIT portal, its public cadastral-map statement, the Comune di Bari open-data cadastral dataset, the official Agenzia delle Entrate Bari cadastral catalogue entry, and a public Regione Puglia ArcGIS parcel layer.

queries.query: Bari catasto mappa particelle catastali geoportale ufficiale Comune Bari
queries.result: Italian-language first-party discovery found the Comune di Bari SIT page describing anonymous access to the Comune's cadastral-map cartography and the official Agenzia delle Entrate Cartografia catastale entry for BARI.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Comune di Bari / Area Vasta Metropoli Terra di Bari SIT
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The official page states that anonymous users can access the entire cadastral-map cartography for a selected municipality, including Bari.

officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Puglia cadastral parcel layer; Bari features observed
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Public layer metadata reports polygon geometry, EPSG:32633 service extent, anonymous query capability, and native cadastral fields including COMUNE, SEZIONE, FOGLIO, ALLEGATO, SVILUPPO and NUMERO.
Catalogue entry identifies BARI cadastral cartography with WFS/WMS distributions, February 2025 update, EPSG:6706 metadata and Bari geographic extent.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Comune di Bari open-data dataset via Regione Puglia catalogue
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official dataset metadata identifies Comune di Bari as holder and describes a CC BY parcel shapefile; it is supplemental and not treated as citywide coverage.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.status: TLS verification failure in curl; official indexed page available
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: The host presented an untrusted certificate chain in this environment. No certificate exception was used. Official search evidence records anonymous Bari cadastral-map access.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.status: TLS verification failure in curl; official indexed page available
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official indexed WMS page lists the Bari QGIS/WMS route http://sit.egov.ba.it/ows/bari/qdjango/89/ and states WGS84/UTM 33N availability; no insecure request was made.
Anonymous ArcGIS layer metadata returned polygon geometry, EPSG:32633, maxRecordCount 1000, capabilities Map/Query/Data, safe native field schema, and Bari-containing extent.

WUP point transformed only for query to EPSG:32633 [657129.063,4552360.952]; query used where=1=1, point geometry, intersects, outFields limited to safe native parcel identifiers/classification, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326. Returned Bari feature OBJECTID 266461, composite cadastral identity A662:A:112:0:0:677.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.status: HTTP 200; 126 features in bounded 300m EPSG:32633 envelope
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Envelope [657000,4552200,657300,4552500] returned 126 parcel polygons. Three full polygons were retained after limiting the sample; no raw native attribute set was retained.
Public metadata returned Comune di Bari holder, parcel shapefile resource, CC BY 4.0 licence, and municipal-owned-only scope. No download was retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The official Comune di Bari SIT claims the municipality's cadastral-map cartography; the queried Regione Puglia ArcGIS layer has a broad Puglia extent and returned Bari parcels.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Bari parcel polygons at the exact WUP point and a bounded surrounding envelope; full citywide completeness and cadastral update lineage were not independently established.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: Comune di Bari SIT and Agenzia delle Entrate/Regione Puglia cadastral publication; local public map evidence is verified.

qualityAssessment.geometryQuality: Three valid Polygon features returned as GeoJSON-compatible rings in EPSG:4326 after server conversion; exact WUP point intersects one returned parcel.
qualityAssessment.crs: Service schema EPSG:32633; query response requested outSR=4326. Agenzia delle Entrate catalogue separately lists EPSG:6706 for the Bari cadastral dataset.
qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: Native field schema is available. Retained sample IDs are composite keys built from COMUNE, SEZIONE, FOGLIO, ALLEGATO, SVILUPPO and NUMERO; OBJECTID is not used as the sole identity.
qualityAssessment.compositeKeyProvenance: id = COMUNE:SEZIONE:FOGLIO:ALLEGATO:SVILUPPO:NUMERO; this is a source-derived cadastral identity representation, not an internal row number.
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: Only safe parcel identifiers/classification fields and geometry were requested. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account or document fields were requested or retained.

blocker: Serial review must independently qualify service coverage, composite identity semantics, CRS/axis handling, update lineage, and anonymous query behavior before runtime use.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [41.1073457979601,16.8713195150444] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted; projected coordinates were used only in the query request.
The exact-point hit and bounded envelope do not prove citywide completeness, and the supplemental municipal-owned dataset is not treated as citywide coverage.

The SIT HTML/WMS host was not accessed with a TLS exception; its official indexed content was recorded, while the working anonymous geometry response came from the public Regione Puglia ArcGIS endpoint.
Packet completion is research evidence only and is not source integration/admission.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception used.
identityPolicy: Retained GeoJSON contains exactly one canonical source-derived identity in properties.id. Native field mapping and composite-key provenance are recorded here, not in GeoJSON properties.
